subject: mosshell
disposition: Disabled saddle-variant review candidate; installed model, saddle prop and mount geometry unchanged.
authorization: Standing owner direction 1 (Meshy, no generation cap); CLAUDE.md art rule (agent-drafted reference)

meshy_model_task.input_images_note: views from the concept task listed (front first)

concept_tasks.prompt: The SAME Mosshell turtle as the first two images (teal-green skin, big friendly dark eyes, brown hexagonal shell plates with moss), unchanged identity, palette and proportions. Reshape the rear of the shell into a flattened saddle hollow: a shallow flat seat area on the back half of the shell where a rider can sit, with a low-profile riding saddle in the style of the third image (worn brown leather, sage-green cloth pad, cream wool lining) fitted into it. Stylised painted creature-game look, not photoreal. No red, maroon or oxblood anywhere. Neutral four-legged standing pose, legs clearly separated from the body and from each other, full body, plain neutral background.
concept_tasks.verdict: rejected: back view cut an open hole into the shell

concept_tasks.prompt: The SAME Mosshell turtle as the first two images (teal-green skin, big friendly dark eyes, brown hexagonal shell plates with moss), unchanged identity, palette and proportions. The rear half of the shell is gently flattened into a shallow flat seat area (the shell stays solid and closed, no hole, no opening, no cavity), and a low-profile riding saddle in the style of the third image (worn brown leather, sage-green cloth pad, cream wool lining) sits strapped onto that flat rear shell. Stylised painted creature-game look, not photoreal. No red, maroon or oxblood anywhere. Neutral four-legged standing pose, legs clearly separated from the body and from each other, full body, plain neutral background.
concept_tasks.verdict: chosen: closed shell, flattened rear with saddle (multi-view gave front + two identical sides; front and side used)

generation_verdict: Identity kept (teal skin, big friendly eyes, mossy brown hex shell); saddle sits on the flattened rear shell; legs short but separated. Saddle keeps two grip hoops from ref 20. Mesh bbox 1.14 x 1.04 x 1.89. Unrigged.

fit.rule: central back/saddle top on the current seat line, never shorter than the installed body

deformation_check.method: assets/creatures/tetherbound/stormursa/source/v3/check_v3_deformation.py (bone rotated 30 deg about world X; median follow ratio of >0.9-weighted distal vertices)

fit_risks: Seat line fitted on the central back column (2.490 m); the top at the current mount column is 2.446 m, so mount_offset must be re-measured on this mesh before activation.
Saddle-variant mesh is a new full-body generation (body plus saddle), not an attachment; identity, rider contact and gameplay footprint (4.99 m long at 2.74 m tall) are unjudged.
